challenges.name: order-export-summary
challenges.title: Summarise the admin's CSV export
challenges.description:
Write summarize_export(csv_text): read the shop admin's order export (header order_id,customer,city,total_vnd) with the csv module and return {"rows", "skipped", "total_vnd", "by_city"}. The text may start with a BOM, customer names with commas are quoted, lines end with 
 or 
 and blank lines are not rows. Every value is a string: convert total_vnd with int(), and skip a row (keep its order_id in "skipped", in file order) when its total is missing or int() rejects it. The test runner prints your dict as JSON.

input.csv_text:
order_id,customer,city,total_vnd
A-1001,Lan,Hà Nội,250000
A-1002,Minh,Đà Nẵng,99000
A-1003,Hoa,Hà Nội,120000

tests.name: Excel export with a BOM before the header, one total left empty
A customer name with a comma is quoted

input.csv_text:
order_id,customer,city,total_vnd
A-3001,"Công ty Sen Vàng, chi nhánh 2",Đà Nẵng,1250000
A-3002,Bảo,Đà Nẵng,80000

tests.name: Totals with decimals or text are skipped (VND has no decimals)
A short row with no total is skipped and blank lines are not rows

input.csv_text:
order_id,customer,city,total_vnd
A-5001,Lan,Hà Nội,200000

A-5002,Minh,Hà Nội
A-5003,Hoa,Cần Thơ,75000
